title: Excavation and Utility Trenching Daily Work Plan
brief: A daily site work plan and material takeoff prepared for a construction laborer crew leader based on civil drawing C-104 and OSHA standards.

slip.document:
# Excavation and Utility Trenching Daily Work Plan
Site: Stonebridge Medical Plaza - Phase 2
Date: 04/14/2026
Superintendent: Lucas Moreau
Foreman: Fatima Tran
Lead Laborer: Andre Bishop

## Trench Specifications and Excavation Scope
Review civil sheet C-104 for the domestic water line tie-in along Grid B.

| Section | Length | Target Depth | Width | Soil Classification |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Segment A | 40 ft | 6.5 ft | 3.0 ft | Type B (Sandy Loam) |
| Segment B | 60 ft | 6.5 ft | 3.0 ft | Type B (Sandy Loam) |
| Segment C | 20 ft | 4.0 ft | 2.5 ft | Type B (Sandy Loam) |

## Daily Work Activities
- Clear organic topsoil along marked alignment from Sta 0+00 to Sta 1+20.
- Operate mini-excavator to open trench according to scheduled dimensions.
- Total linear footage to trench today is 140 linear feet across all segments.
- Set trench box shoring system before allowing pipe layers into Segment A and Segment B.
- Position trench access ladders so workers travel no more than 50 feet laterally to an exit.
- Hand-dig test pits to expose existing 2-inch gas main crossing Sta 0+85 per utility locate ticket.
- Bed pipe with 6 inches of crushed stone #57 and backfill in 8-inch lifts.
- Compact backfill to 95 percent standard Proctor density using vibratory plate compactor.

## Safety Controls
- Daily trench inspection completed by designated competent person prior to entry.
- Hard hats, high-visibility Class 2 vests, and steel-toe boots mandatory inside trench zone.
- Continuous air monitoring required if organic odor or utility conflict is identified.
- Keep excavated spoil pile at least 2 feet back from trench edge.

errors.quote: Total linear footage to trench today is 140 linear feet
errors.explanation: The table lists Segment A (40 ft), Segment B (60 ft), and Segment C (20 ft), which sum to 120 linear feet, not 140 linear feet.
errors.fix: Total linear footage to trench today is 120 linear feet

errors.quote: workers travel no more than 50 feet laterally to an exit
errors.explanation: OSHA 1926.651(c)(2) requires that in trenches 4 feet or deeper, safe means of egress (such as ladders) must be located so that workers do not have to travel more than 25 feet laterally.
errors.fix: workers travel no more than 25 feet laterally to an exit
